name: Acute coronary syndrome
clinical_note: Time-critical. ECG within 10 minutes, immediate escalation.

name: Stable angina
clinical_note: Exertional chest pain relieved by rest. Needs cardiology workup.

name: Pulmonary embolism
clinical_note: Consider Wells score. Sudden breathlessness with chest pain.

name: Meningitis
clinical_note: Fever with neck stiffness and photophobia. Do not delay treatment.

name: Appendicitis
clinical_note: Migratory right lower quadrant pain. Surgical review required.

name: Type 2 diabetes mellitus
clinical_note: Classic osmotic symptoms. Check random glucose and HbA1c.

name: Asthma
clinical_note: Episodic wheeze and breathlessness. Assess peak flow.

name: Upper respiratory tract infection
clinical_note: Self-limiting. Supportive care and safety-netting advice.

name: Migraine
clinical_note: Recurrent, often unilateral, with photophobia and nausea.

name: Gastroenteritis
clinical_note: Hydration is the priority. Safety-net for dehydration.
